decisions.reason: As a module that builds on the firm’s established postpress portfolio and remains marketed on its own page in 2024, it still offers option value at likely modest carrying cost, so management would keep it unless clearer negative evidence emerges.

This close-to-core folding add-on has documented customer use, fits the firm’s automation direction, and should be relatively inexpensive to carry as part of a modular range, so the option value of keeping it on the market remains high.
